### Meaning
| infl.      | class        | meaning                                                        |
| ---------- | ------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| ~          | *n.*         | unluck, trouble, badness, flaw, defect, fault                  |
| ~an        | *adj.*       | poor quality, no good, defective, faulty, troublesome, unlucky |
### Connotation
- evil
- corrupted
### Antonym
- [[Sen'fi/Glossary/Concepts/we\|we]]
### Etymology
#### Glyph
凶, showing a rotated person falling into a pit -> unfortunate, disaster/disgrace, evil.
#### Sound
- *a priori:* ks=destruction, u=melancholy
